# How much can you put in your HSA in 2026?

> Free calculator for the 2026 HSA contribution limit — self-only $4,400 or family $8,750, the $1,000 age-55 catch-up, HDHP qualification bounds, monthly proration for partial-year eligibility, and the last-month rule's testing-period tradeoff. Entirely client-side, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
